screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
Build five altars on one level: one central altar and four ordinary altars three blocks north, south, east and west.

Place one Wolfsbane on each outer altar and one Moonbane Pearl in the center. Right-click the central altar with an empty hand.

The visitor tries to approach from at least sixteen blocks away, then falls back to the altar if no route works. A broken or blocked ritual returns its offerings.

The Alpha recipe remains different: a Badge in the center and Pearls outside.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.m:
The merchant stays for 12000 game ticks: ten minutes at 20 TPS. Trading does not pause this timer; unloading his chunk removes him. Recruitment ends this temporary expiry rule.

Each merchant offers six different recipes chosen from nine. Uses are limited and do not restock.

Moonbane Pearl: 6 Wolfsbane + 1 Diamond, or 12 Emeralds + 4 Wolfsbane.
Werewolf Potion: 4 Wolfsbane + 2 Emeralds.
Wolfsbane Potion: 4 Silver + 2 Emeralds.
Silver/Wolfsbane exchanges: 4 for 2 in either direction.
Other offers exchange Emeralds or Iron for Silver, and Emeralds for Wolfsbane.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
Become a werewolf and learn Pack Oath. Hold a Werewolf Badge and right-click the merchant, then confirm recruitment to spend one Badge.

Pack Oath has three ranks. Without it you cannot recruit. Before passing the Alpha Trial, capacity is one; afterward ranks 1/2/3 allow 1/2/3 companions.

Recruits start at tier zero and stop trading. Dead and hunting companions still occupy slots.

Respeccing or curing preserves records and belongings. Excess companions rest; relearning restores access to purchased tiers.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.c:
Follow: stays with you and never fights back, even when attacked. Monsters do not actively choose him as a target, but stray attacks, explosions and environmental damage can still hurt him. Prefer Guard in dangerous areas.

Guard: assists your attacks, defends you and retaliates against valid attackers who hurt him. Creepers, the owner, allies, owned pets and PvP-protected players are excluded.

Rest: stops moving and fighting at the current spot. Recall remains available.

Follow and Guard can rejoin you across dimensions. Switching modes clears the old combat target.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.i:
Right-click your companion to open his controls. Use Inventory while he is alive, loaded, in your dimension and within eight blocks. Sneak-right-click opens the inventory directly.

The nine slots accept items you place manually. Companions do not pick up ground items.

Belongings survive death and remain in the owner-bound record. Loot that does not fit after a hunt drops at the return point.

Only the owner may operate this inventory. The C overview and werewolf-menu entry remain available.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.a:
The individual controls show a detached model preview. Drag to rotate it and use the wheel to zoom. Name & Skin also previews your selection; Apply Skin saves it.

Model family follows the server world setting. Classic and Modern remember separate built-in coats. Names allow up to 32 Unicode characters; saving an empty name restores the coat name.

In the overview, set how all your companions address you. Use up to 16 characters and Save; Default restores the localized default (Chinese: 主人, English: my lord).

Companion dialogue is delivered only to its owner. Appearance changes cannot be applied while hunting or dead.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.h:
Hunt removes the live companion for 1.5–3 Minecraft days. Other commands become unavailable except Recall.

Loot is drawn only when he returns. Rolls equal elapsed days times the tier coefficient, rounded down; coefficients are 4/5/6/8 for tiers 0/1/2/3. Time is capped at the planned duration. The table includes common Overworld loot, minerals and Wolfsbane.

Every ended hunt starts a three-day cooldown. Early recall settles elapsed time; immediate recall gives no loot but still starts the full cooldown.

Recall works across dimensions and unloaded chunks. Offline/no-space delivery waits without adding rewards. Sleep and /time do not skip these game-tick timers.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.u:
Recruits start at tier zero. Upgrades to tiers 1/2/3 cost 2/4/8 Moonbane Pearls. Pack Oath sets the tier cap; hunting/dead companions cannot upgrade.

Tier 0: 30 health, 4 attack, no innate reduction.
Tier 1: 40 health, 6 attack, 10% reduction.
Tier 2: 50 health, 8 attack, 20% reduction.
Tier 3: 60 health, 10 attack, 30% reduction.

After five seconds without injury, loaded companions heal 1/1.5/2/2.5 health per second by tier. Upgrades do not instantly heal them to full.

Tier increases hunt roll count without changing individual loot weights.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
A fallen companion keeps his name, skins, tier and inventory and still occupies a slot. Spend one Werewolf Badge in management to revive him beside you at full health.

If no safe space is available, revival does not charge the Badge. Recall cannot replace revival. Death and revival do not reset the hunt cooldown.

C opens the overview by default; key bindings can be changed in Controls. Existing saved bindings remain until you change or reset them. Escape returns to the previous screen.

Servers can disable companions with gameplay.enableCompanions. Records/items remain, while hunt and cooldown timers pause until re-enabled.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.s:
Choose Sort in the overview or individual controls. Stand near your companion and select Register storage. The first registration uses the companion's position as the work point. Sneak-right-click a chest or barrel to add it; repeat to remove it. Open companion management to finish registration, or wait five minutes.
Storage must be within eight blocks horizontally and four vertically of the work point. Register up to 24 containers. A double chest counts as one, and both halves must be in range. Vanilla chests, trapped chests and barrels are supported.
Start sorting keeps the companion at work and periodically checks registered storage. Consolidate favors containers already holding the most of each matching item. Merge stacks only fills existing partial stacks without using empty slots.
Only stackable items with identical items and full components are merged. Item stack limits are respected. The companion inventory is never used as transit storage, and excess items remain in their source containers.
Open, obstructed, locked, protected, unlooted and unloaded containers are skipped. Work pauses when the owner logs out, leaves the dimension, or the companion leaves the work area. Another mode or recall stops sorting. No chunks are force-loaded.
Reset work area clears registrations and moves the work point to the companion without changing stored items. The server setting enableCompanionSorting defaults to true; disabling stops sorting while retaining registrations.
